title: Factor site content and newsroom into submodules with S3 publish path

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Epic scope: (1) extract src/blog to AnthusAI/anthus-blog-content submodule at same path; (2) mount anthus-semantic-knowledge-base at newsroom/; (3) Amplify submodule init; (4) content-repo GitHub Action to sync MDX/images to S3 and optionally trigger site rebuild. Goal: decouple content pushes from full 30min site deploys.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Build verified locally (EXIT=0) with submodule at src/site-content. Excluded README.md from Gatsby source. Added deploy.yml workflow with Gatsby cache for incremental builds. Removed amplify.yml. AWS deploy steps are conditional on vars being set, so build+cache can be tested before AWS is configured.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Both cold builds succeeded on GitHub Actions (Anth.us ~23min, content repo ~19min). Caching enabled. Pushing AGENTS.md update to trigger a cached build and measure incremental timing.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: VERIFIED: Cached build completed in 1m22s (vs 23min cold). Gatsby incremental caching works on GitHub Actions. Build+cache pipeline confirmed. AWS deploy steps skipped (no vars set yet). Remaining: run scripts/setup-aws-publish.sh with AWS creds, set GitHub Actions Variables on both repos, point DNS at CloudFront.
